QF.id: I Codes of Conduct and Investor Protection_16

question.text: In ETCD, fraudulent and unfair trade practices are addressed under:

answer.text: SEBI guidelines/regulations related to fraudulent and unfair trade practices, which are applicable to ETCD

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI has powers to prohibit fraudulent and unfair trade practices, and SEBI guidelines/regulations on such practices are expressly applicable to Exchange Traded Currency Derivatives (ETCD). The Trap: These are SEBI guidelines/regulations applicable to securities-market activity, not provisions of the Companies Act, FEMA, or tax law. Note: The workbook frames this as SEBI guidelines/regulations on fraudulent and unfair trade practices being applicable to ETCD.
